title: Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. Now Trading on the Texas Stock Exchange
summary: Common and Preferred Stock Become Primary Listings on TXSE
body_markdown:
**DALLAS – October 8, 2026 –**[Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc.](https://texascapitalbank.com/) (TXSE: TCBI), the parent company of Texas Capital, today announced that its common and preferred stock have commenced trading on the[Texas Stock Exchange (“TXSE”)](https://www.txse.com/) , following the transfer of their primary listings from Nasdaq.


Texas Capital Bancshares’ common and preferred stock began trading on TXSE at market open today under the ticker symbols, “TCBI” and “TCBI PRB,” respectively. The company expects to change the ticker symbols to “TXCP” and “TXCP PRB,” respectively, on November 9, 2026. No action is required by stockholders in connection with the ticker symbol change.


“As the only full-service financial services firm founded and headquartered in Texas, Texas Capital is proud to align with the only national securities exchange, built, headquartered and incorporated in the state we call home,” said Rob C. Holmes, Chairman, President & CEO of Texas Capital. “Texas policymakers have continued to strengthen the state’s business and capital markets environment, helping create the conditions for new financial infrastructure to thrive. The Texas Stock Exchange has paired that environment with an experienced leadership team, purpose-built technology, strong institutional backing and an issuer-focused approach to listings, making TXSE a compelling long-term relationship for Texas Capital and our shareholders.”


The transfer marks another milestone in Texas Capital’s connection with TXSE, following the September 16, 2026, transfer of the firm’s two Texas-focused ETFs, which became the exchange’s first primary listings and first exchange-traded funds to trade on TXSE.


Texas Capital and TXSE will commemorate the company’s move to the exchange with a closing bell ceremony on Monday, November 9, 2026, in Dallas, bringing together leaders from both organizations and members of the Texas business community. The ceremony will be livestreamed beginning at approximately 2:50 p.m. CT and can be viewed online[here](https://www.txse.com/live) .


## About Texas Capital


Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. (TXSE: TCBI), a member of the Russell 2000® Index and the S&P MidCap 400®, is the parent company of Texas Capital Bank (“TCB”). Texas Capital is the collective brand name for TCB and its separate, non-bank affiliates and wholly owned subsidiaries. Texas Capital is a full-service financial services firm that delivers customized solutions to businesses, entrepreneurs and individual customers. Founded in 1998, the institution is headquartered in Dallas with offices in Austin, Fort Worth, Houston, San Antonio, Chicago, Los Angeles and New York City, and has a network of clients across the country. With the ability to service clients through their entire lifecycles, Texas Capital has established commercial banking, consumer banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management capabilities. All services are subject to applicable laws, regulations and service terms. Deposit and lending products and services are offered by TCB. For deposit products, member FDIC. For more information, please visit[texascapital.com.](https://texascapitalbank.com/)


Trading in securities and financial instruments, strategic advisory, and other investment banking activities are performed by TCBI Securities, Inc., doing business as Texas Capital Securities. TCBI Securities, Inc. is a member of FINRA and SIPC and has registered with the SEC and other state securities regulators as a broker dealer. TCBI Securities, Inc. is a subsidiary of TCB. All investing involves risks, including the loss of principal. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Securities and other investment products offered by TCBI Securities, Inc. are not FDIC insured, may lose value and are not bank guaranteed.
